# Eye Diagram

`maiman.components.EyeDiagram` · category **Measurements** · [all components](index.md)

Bins a received waveform into an eye diagram.

Emits a fixed-size histogram rather than the waveform: the size depends on
the requested resolution and not on how long the simulation ran. That is what
keeps a multi-million-sample buffer from ever reaching a browser.

## Ports

| Port | Direction | Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `in` | input | electrical |
| `out` | output | metric |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Range | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `span_symbols` | `2.0` |  | 1.0 …  | Symbols across the horizontal axis |
| `time_bins` | `128.0` |  | 8.0 …  | Horizontal resolution |
| `amplitude_bins` | `128.0` |  | 8.0 …  | Vertical resolution |
| `interpolate` | `True` | flag |  | Draw each transition between samples by band-limited interpolation, not as a step |
